• Oversell race-condition: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE with ascending variant-ID lock ordering prevents
deadlocks under simultaneous checkout. Chose pessimistic over optimistic locking because write-heavy,
high-conﬂict checkout makes optimistic retry loops unacceptable for UX.
• RabbitMQ over Redis Pub/Sub: durable queues + DLQ ensure order conﬁrmation emails survive
consumer restarts and failed jobs are captured for retry — Redis Pub/Sub silently drops messages when
consumer is oﬄine.
• VNPay integration: HMAC-SHA512 IPN signature veriﬁcation prevents payment spooﬁng; handles both
sync redirect and async IPN ﬂows.
• MinIO (S3-compatible): decouples binary assets from application DB; enables independent scaling and
CDN fronting.
• GPT-3.5 chatbot: per-session sliding-window memory (last 20 messages) in ConcurrentHashMap —
stateless REST API, prevents context overﬂow while maintaining coherence.

github.com/truong-backend/diem-danh | webdiemdanh.deploy-my-project.site | View Report

Attendance); core queries are multi-hop traversals O(depth) — equivalent SQL requires 5+ JOIN chains that
degrade as data grows.
• Concurrent QR scan race-condition: Redis SET NX EX distributed lock per student–session pair before
Neo4j write — prevents duplicate records without DB-level transactions. JWT-signed QR token (300 s TTL)
invalidated immediately on refresh; no DB round-trip on every scan.
• T wo attendance paths + audit trail: QR self-check-in (auto LATE after 15 min) and teacher manual
override with updatedBy / updatedAt / method=MANUAL stored as Neo4j relationship properties.

MANUAL_UPDATE → notify student; DLQ captures failures for retry — missed notiﬁcations directly aﬀect
grade records, making Redis Pub/Sub’s ﬁre-and-forget insuﬃcient.
• Real-time dashboard (W ebSocket/STOMP , 100+ connections): RabbitMQ consumer broadcasts to
teacher clients — decouples write path from UI push; burst scan load cannot block HTTP threads.
• Excel export (Apache POI): async background job generates per-class reports with attendance rate
calculation — eliminates manual reporting eﬀort.

•Built an ETL pipeline merging 10 source tables into a 581,603-order master dataset (87 cols, 1,568 SKUs); resolved sentinel dates,

cleaning pipeline handled negative ozone values and 0.036% missing data via city-specific interpolation.

from thermal inversion, winter-spring seasonality (Nov–Feb), and PM2.5–PM10 collinearity (r = 0.95).

µg/m3, MAE 10.232, R 2 = 0.586), achieving 72.5% health-risk bucket accuracy and 76.6% recall on hazardous alerts.
•Deployed via FastAPI + React dashboard (Docker, Render) with 24-hour forecasts, what-if scenarios, and Activity Planner
backed by 90% conformal prediction intervals.

evidence_text:
Alpha Cinema - Online & On-site Movie Ticket Booking System | Microservices-based System Feb 2026 - May 2026
Full-stack Developer | 3-member team
GitHub: https://github.com/tuan04/alpha_cinema
Technologies: Spring Boot, Spring AI, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, React, Redux Toolkit, WebSocket, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS EC2.
• Built an asynchronous AI review-moderation pipeline using Kafka and Spring AI, decoupling review submission from AI processing while transitioning
reviews from Pending to Approved or Hidden and delivering moderation results to users in real time via STOMP/WebSocket.
• Implemented progressive showtime retrieval based on user selections, fetching cinemas, available dates, and showtimes on demand instead of loading the
full booking dataset upfront.
• Built React booking interfaces for movie discovery and interactive seat selection, using TanStack Query for server-state fetching/caching and Redux
Toolkit for client-side booking state.
• Implemented a Redis-backed shopping cart synchronized with Redux Toolkit and integrated cart state with checkout and payment flows.
• Built a GitHub Actions deployment pipeline for a Docker Compose stack with 10+ containers, automating image builds and deployment to AWS EC2.
Zola - Mobile Messaging & Chat Application Mar 2026 - May 2026
Full-stack Developer | 5-member team
GitHub: https://github.com/tuan04/zalo_clone
Technologies: NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, Socket.IO, OpenAI, React, React Native, Expo, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS EC2, Nginx.
• Built a multi-device authentication system with OTP verification, refresh-token sessions, QR-code login, and real-time remote logout across web and
mobile clients, using Redis for temporary auth state and Socket.IO for login/logout events.
• Integrated OpenAI response streaming with Socket.IO, allowing users to receive generated content in chunks instead of waiting for the complete response.
• Built a RAG pipeline over application documentation and platform guidelines, using MongoDB vector search to retrieve relevant knowledge and augment
OpenAI responses based on user queries.
• Implemented real-time chat presence and interaction features across React and React Native clients, including online status and typing indicators
synchronized through Socket.IO.
• Automated Docker-based deployment to AWS EC2 with GitHub Actions, configuring Nginx as a reverse proxy and enabling HTTPS for deployed
services.

containerized the infrastructure with Docker.

- Streaming & Processing: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark (PySpark, Streaming)
- Orchestration & Infra: Apache Airflow, Docker, Docker Compose

MinIO) on the client’s on-premise infrastructure.

Automated ETL Pipeline on A WS GitHub · 2026
• Built a cloud-native ETL SaaS platform on A WS for uploading CSV ﬁles and returning cleaned, analysis-ready
Parquet outputs via an automated pipeline.
• Implemented a serverless data pipeline using A WS Lambda, S3 triggers, and DynamoDB for job tracking,
performing deduplication, null imputation, and IQR-based outlier removal.
• Developed a FastAPI backend with Cognito JWT auth and a React dashboard, containerized with Docker and
deployed on self-managed Kubernetes, served via CloudFront + ALB.
Retail Sales F orecasting with Explainable ML GitHub · 2025
• Designed a synthetic data generator simulating 2 years of daily retail transactions across 10 stores, 35 products,
and 5 categories incorporating seasonality, Vietnamese holidays (Tet, National Day), and weather eﬀects.
• Engineered 55 temporal features and trained an Optuna-tuned LightGBM with time-aware splitting, outper-
forming Prophet (RMSE: 11.76 vs 11.86, W APE: 28.2% vs 29.13%).
• Applied SHAP for model interpretability, revealing product-level trends and recent sales (728 days) as key
drivers, with actionable insights for weekend and December demand planning.
AI-Powered Cocktail Suggestions GitHub · 2025
• Developed a recommendation system leveraging AI embeddings and pgvector on PostgreSQL for eﬃcient vector
similarity search and personalized suggestions.
• Designed an end-to-end pipeline with vector search and deployed an interactive interface using Streamlit for
real-time recommendations.
Human Action Recognition with LS-ViT GitHub · 2025
• Built a video classiﬁcation model for human action recognition using the HMDB51 dataset.
• Implemented Long-Short Term Video Transformer (LS-ViT) to jointly capture spatial and temporal features.
• Achieved 96% top-1 accuracy in the training dataset and 63.88% in the testing dataset.

evidence_text:
FPT Software – Ho Chi Minh 09/2024 – 01/2025
Business Analyst Intern | Trainer Management System (HR Management System)
• Worked alongside the BA team to gather requirements from stakeholders across a 2-phase HR Management
System project, producing62 Use Casesand156 Business Ruleswith complete screen-flows and wireframes
– delivering a specification set the dev team implemented with minimal rework.
• Authored the full SRS and BRD covering both phases, giving the .NET and React teams unambiguous docu-
mentation that shortened onboarding into the codebase.
• Collaboratedwiththefront-end(React)andback-end(.NET)teamsduringimplementation, translatingbusiness
rules into technical requirements to keep feature delivery on schedule.
• Built and executed a manual QA test suite covering all 62 use cases, validating functional correctness against
stakeholder requirements and reducing post-release defects.
• Took part in system design workshops and stakeholder communication sessions, sharpening the cross-functional
and requirement-gathering skills later applied as a project lead on DevPool.

DevPool – Project-based IT Staffing Management System 08/2025 – 12/2025
Full-Stack Developer & Project Lead | Team size: 4
• Designed a relational database of nearly 40 tables to model the end-to-end staffing workflow, giving the
platform a scalable single source of truth for talent, project, and financial data.
• Built full-stack Authentication & Authorization (login/register/logout), User Management, and Talent Man-
agement with an AI-powered profile-extraction feature reaching90% extraction accuracy– cutting manual
data-entry time for recruiters.
• Developed the Apply Tracking Management module end-to-end (API + React UI), streamlining the candidate-
to-project allocation pipeline.
• Led a team of 4 as project lead, applying BA techniques to gather requirements from stakeholders and mentors,
plan sprints, and keep delivery on schedule.
• Owned deployment and testing across all critical workflows, hardening the system with Docker/CI-CD pipelines
and keeping core API response times under 5s under normal load.
Tech Stack:ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 9), EF Core, DI, Unit of Work, AutoMapper, PostgreSQL, Docker,
CI/CD, ReactJS, Firebase.
Innosphere – Short-Term Job Recruitment Platform 04/2025 – 07/2025
Back-End Developer & Project Lead | Team size: 3
• Designed the system architecture and SQL Server database schema for a job-recruitment platform connecting
workers and recruiters for short-term/event-based roles.
• Built the core back-end modules – Worker Management, Recruiter Management, Authentication/Login/User –
with secure JWT-based auth, forming the platform’s main business logic.
• Integrated a live PayOS payment gateway to handle real transactions, enabling the platform to process genuine
payments rather than a mock flow.
• Piloted the platform with20+ real users, validating core workflows in production-like conditions and gathering
feedback that fed into two rounds of stabilization fixes.
Tech Stack: ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 8), EF Core, DI, Unit of Work, SQL Server, Docker, CI/CD,
ReactJS, PayOS, Firebase.

of 981.32, and MAE of 678.56.
Identified key insights: average revenue increased by approximately 39% during promotions; revenue
exhibited strong seasonality towards the end of the year; and 'Sales_lag_14' was the most important feature
for revenue forecasting.
Sales Forecasting Using Big Data
Analyzed over 1 million sales records from 1,115 stores, performing data preprocessing, EDA, time-series
analysis, and feature engineering to identify factors influencing revenue.
Trained and compared three machine learning models (Linear Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost);
XGBoost achieved an MAE of 561.15 and an RMSE of 823.96 reductions of 33% and 30% respectively
compared to Linear Regression and was selected to forecast revenue for the subsequent six weeks.
Derived insights: Customer count showed the strongest correlation with sales (r = 0.82), while promotions
showed a correlation of r = 0.37; days with promotions generated €8,229 in d aily revenue approximately
39% higher than non-promotion days and revenue per customer increased from €8.94 to €10.18.

Description: Building an online job recruitment platform that connects job seekers and employers, while also helping employers manage
application profiles and integrate AI for CV analysis and evaluation.
Responsibilities:
• Design and develop a backend RESTful API using Spring Boot for features displaying job details, apply for a job, managing application
profiles, processing CVs and automated email delivery.
• Design entity relationships and database mappings for services such as companies, job applications, users, and jobs using JPA/Hibernate,
including one-to-many and many-to-one relationships.
• Implemented exception handling using a Global Exception Handler to provide standardized API error responses.
• Designed and implemented responsive frontend interfaces for job details, job applications, recruiter management, and candidate profile
(CV) processing. Integrated RESTful APIs using Axios, managed global state with Zustand, and developed reusable, type-safe components
using ReactJS, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
• Implement authentication and authorization using Spring Security, JWT, and access control based on Candidate, Employer, and
Administrator roles.
• Designed inter-service communication using OpenFeign for synchronous API calls and Apache Kafka for asynchronous event processing,
ensuring reliable message delivery and reducing coupling between microservices.
• Implement a chat function between candidates and recruiters and provide real-time notifications using WebSocket and STOMP.

Movie Financial Success Analysis 2026
GitHub: github.com/AlizCules/Movie-Financial-Success-Analysis
Python · pandas · TMDb API · XGBoost · scikit-learn
Analyzed 2,597 movies from the TMDb Official API (2000–2025) to assess pre-release financial-success signals, forming a validated cohort
of 1,646 films.
Audited core financial fields, finding 32.9% missing budget values and 32.3% missing revenue values; documented how this missingness
shaped the final analytical cohort.
Identified two pre-release success signals — theatrical release breadth (28.6% for 0–5 markets vs. 77.7% for 30+ markets) and
franchise/collection status (81.7% vs. 48.5% within the Action genre) — providing interpretable signals for early distribution and IP-
investment screening, while noting these are associations rather than causal claims.
Engineered leakage-safe pre-release features across budget, genre, collection, release characteristics, and time-aware franchise historywhile excluding revenue and other post-release signals.
Evaluated XGBoost with nested cross-validation, achieving 0.7195 Macro-F1 and 0.7224 balanced accuracy on out-of-sample predictions,
demonstrating potential for early financial-risk screening before release.
Vietnamese E-commerce Review Analytics & RAG 2026
GitHub: github.com/AlizCules/Vietnamese-Ecommerce-Sentiment-RAG
Python · pandas · scikit-learn · TF-IDF · FAISS · FastAPI
Prepared 5,971 Vietnamese e-commerce reviews as 5,162 analysis-ready records through normalization, deduplication, and conflicthandling, enabling customer-feedback analysis at scale.
Profiled rating-derived sentiment across 2,217 positive, 2,074 negative, and 871 neutral reviews, revealing a customer base nearly evenly
split between positive and negative experiences — a baseline for tracking sentiment shifts over time.
Compared text-classification models against a majority-class baseline (0.200 Macro-F1) and selected Linear SVM, which achieved 0.9098Macro-F1 and 0.9329 test accuracy — a large lift over guessing the dominant class, reliable enough to support automated triage of large
feedback volumes.
Investigated classification errors and found neutral reviews were the most difficult category (F1 ≈ 0.823), particularly for short or ambiguous
customer comments.
Indexed 82,677 review documents for evidence retrieval across topics such as delivery, packaging, and product quality; manual evaluation
achieved Precision@5 = 0.507 across 15 representative queries, enabling evidence-based review lookup for customer-service or product
analysis.
Delivered sentiment prediction, evidence retrieval, and analytical metrics through a FastAPI-based interactive web interface for end-to-end
review exploration.
PaySim Transaction Fraud Analysis 2025
GitHub: github.com/AlizCules/Paysim-Fraud-Detection
Python · SQL · DuckDB · pandas · Power BI · scikit-learn
Analyzed 6.36M simulated mobile-money transactions with only 0.129% fraud, using SQL and Python to surface transaction patterns
associated with elevated fraud risk and support transaction review prioritization.
Identified fraud concentration in TRANSFER and CASH_OUT transactions; transactions ≥1M showed a 2.07% simulated fraud rate versus
0.14% for the 100K–1M band, highlighting segments that warrant closer review in the simulated setting.
Developed a DuckDB/SQL analytical layer and Power BI-ready reporting datasets — with a data dictionary and dashboard guide —
covering fraud rate and amount by transaction type, hour, day, amount band, high-risk segment, and model alert volume, ready for a fraud-
ops team to use for daily monitoring.
Designed a time-based train/validation/test workflow that preserved natural fraud prevalence in validation and test while addressing severe
class imbalance only during training.
Compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost across pre- and post-transaction monitoring scenarios, using validation-selected thresholds to examine how model scores could prioritize higher-risk transactions for review.
Random Forest achieved 0.9997 F1 at a 1.54% alert rate on the final PaySim test period; the unusually high result is explicitly treated as
simulator-specific rather than evidence of real-world fraud performance.
